summary: Tonix Pharmaceuticals filed a routine Form 8-K on October 15, 2026, furnishing preliminary third-quarter 2026 operating results under Item 2.02 and incorporating them into Item 8.01. Management estimated TONMYA net revenue of $14.0–$15.0 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with cash and cash equivalents of approximately $162.8 million. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural mechanic was disclosed. The filing is preliminary, subject to quarter-end closing adjustments, and carries no special-situation or risk-arbitrage angle; watch for final results and any material revisions.
